articles.title: Bianca Belair turned WWE success into a growing fortune: Insider her championships, endorsements, fashion and entertainment ventures that expanded her income and strengthened her financial profile
articles.summary: Discover how WWE superstar Bianca Belair transformed her impressive wrestling success into a thriving financial empire through endorsements, fashion ventures, and entertainment projects.
articles.body: Bianca Belair has developed from a rising WWE performer into one of the company’s most recognisable women’s wrestling stars. Her athletic background, distinctive “EST” persona and major championship moments have helped establish a brand that extends well beyond match results. That growing visibility has also created opportunities in merchandise, sponsorships, fashion and entertainment.According to Celebrity Net Worth, Bianca Belair’s estimated net worth is between $3 million and $5 million, with several 2026 reports placing the figure around $4 million. WWE does not publicly disclose the complete compensation packages of individual performers, meaning salary, bonuses, merchandise royalties and other earnings can vary.Bianca Belair’s growing fortune reflects WWE successBelair’s financial growth has closely followed her rise inside WWE. After entering the company’s developmental system, she became a major fixture of its women’s division and eventually established herself as a championship-level performer.Her breakthrough came with the 2021 Women’s Royal Rumble victory, which led to her WrestleMania 37 main-event match against Sasha Banks. The historic bout made Belair one of the most prominent names in WWE’s women’s division and strengthened her commercial profile.Her championship résumé has continued to add value to that profile. Belair became the longest-reigning Raw Women’s Champion with a 420-day reign, while her later Women’s Tag Team Championship victory with Jade Cargill helped make her a WWE Women’s Triple Crown Champion.Bianca Belair expands earnings beyond wrestlingWWE remains the foundation of Belair’s income, but her commercial opportunities have become increasingly important. Her merchandise presence, premium live event appearances, licensing opportunities and sponsorship work provide potential revenue streams beyond a standard wrestling contract.WWE performers can receive compensation from several sources, including merchandise, appearances, licensing and event-related bonuses. Because individual contracts are generally private, publicly reported salary estimates should be treated as estimates rather than confirmed figures.Belair has also been connected with brands including C4 Energy, Fenty Beauty, DraftKings and Slim Jim in recent reporting. WWE and C4 announced their partnership with Belair among the company's featured athletes in 2021, demonstrating how her fitness-focused image translated naturally into commercial campaigns.Bianca Belair builds a powerful media brandBelair’s biggest advantage outside the ring is the recognisable identity she has created around her WWE character. Her signature look, elaborate entrances and distinctive ring gear have become important parts of her public image.She personally designs and makes much of her wrestling gear, a skill that began developing seriously before becoming an important part of her WWE presentation. Her fashion work has included creating gear for herself and for her husband, fellow WWE performer Montez Ford. She has also discussed ambitions of eventually taking her fashion interests further.That creative identity has helped Belair stand apart in an increasingly commercial WWE environment. Her look can translate into merchandise, promotional campaigns, video games, television appearances and other forms of entertainment.Her media footprint expanded further with “Love & WWE: Bianca & Montez,” the Hulu reality series featuring Belair and Montez Ford, and WWE confirmed the show's launch in 2023, while the series gave viewers a behind-the-scenes look at their professional and personal lives.The combination of championship credibility, a distinctive fashion identity, sponsorship appeal and television exposure has therefore given Belair several avenues for continued commercial growth. articles.title: NFL Week 5 Power Rankings Round-up 2026: Raiders hold ground after loss
articles.summary: The Raiders kept respect in the power rankings for Week 5 despite loss to the Chiefs.
articles.body:
In week four the Las Vegas Raiders lost to the Chiefs, but were in a neck-and-neck battle for much of the contest, proving that their hot start to the season start is for real. Despite Kirk Cousins going for 365 passing yards and two passing touchdowns, Brock Bowers going for 86 receiving yards and Michael Mayer going for 82 receiving yards, Las Vegas was unable to come away with the win.

Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III went for 177 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns, and Tyquan Thornton went for 111 receiving yards and two touchdowns, helping Kansas City win their fourth game of the year and remain undefeated.

Las Vegas is still firmly in the playoff mix, with a 3-1 record heading into Week 5. Their status among the contending teams in the league did not greatly diminish, as they showed they were capable of giving the Chiefs a great fight. After earning an average power ranking of 10.8 following Week 3, let's round up some power rankings and see how the Raiders are viewed heading into Week 3.

"Where has this franchise been? Andy Reid has the most wins (7) of any coach − including the Raiders' − at Allegiant Stadium. And while Klint Kubiak's troops arguably legitimized themselves by nearly knocking off Reid's Chiefs on Sunday, they'll be challenged to keep it up − the Patriots, Bills, Rams, 49ers, Seahawks and Broncos are among the Silver and Black's next seven opponents."

Chad Graff and Josh Kendall, The Athletic — 13

"The Raiders lost, but they've got to come away from Sunday's game feeling pretty good. They've already matched their win total from a year ago. New coach Klint Kubiak is exceeding expectations, and even 38-year-old Kirk Cousins is slinging it. There's not a lot to be worried about in Vegas given what this season could've looked like."

"There are no moral victories here, but the Raiders sure have plenty to be proud of after their narrow Week 4 loss to Kansas City . The upstart Las Vegas squad battled with big brother for four quarters and nearly handed the Chiefs their first loss of 2026. Kirk Cousins is playing fantastically, and the defensive additions have helped transform the team from an also-ran into a squad that deserves a ton of respect. I'm not sure how the story will end, but I'm glad we're along for the ride."

"Even after the Raiders' heartbreaking loss to the Chiefs, there's a sense that first-time coach Klint Kubiak is building something special in Las Vegas. The Raiders were competitive for four quarters against Kansas City. They are better than expected and should be a competitive team each week, especially with quarterback Kirk Cousins playing at a high level. With the Chargers 0-4 and the Broncos 2-2, it's not crazy to suggest Las Vegas can make a playoff run in Year 1 of the Kubiak era."

"They lost for the first time Sunday, but they showed they are a good team by pushing the Chiefs. At 3-1, they are one of the surprise teams in the league."

"Las Vegas outgained the Chiefs 437-398, which is of little consolation but shows Vegas was close to knocking off Kansas City. If anything, the Raiders validated their hot start with a close loss to a Chiefs team that is 4-0 and has won nine of the last 10 AFC West titles."

"While aggressive, the Raiders will miss the mark at times, but they're good enough to hang with the NFL's upper-echelon teams. Keep in mind that playoff-caliber clubs have a better chance of capitalizing on Las Vegas' mistakes."

"I don't know what happens from here, but the fact that the Raiders have gotten incredible production out of a handful of players the previous regime deemed unplayable—and are getting game-changing plays from a 2026 fifth-round pick in the secondary—have me more confident in the John Spytek-Tom Brady mind meld than I've ever been."

The Raiders approach another matchup against a Super Bowl contender in the New England Patriots next week. The Patriots secured a huge bounce back win against the Buffalo Bills in Week 4 and are now 2-2 after they were facing a potential 1-3 start to the year.

The Raiders' 3-0 season may quickly turn into a 3-2 record and a fight to have a comfortable advantage in the standings if they do not attack the Patriots and do what is necessary to win. New England is not on as nearly as good of a roll as Kansas City is at this juncture of the offseason, and the tight loss to the Chiefs is still a boost of morale heading into Week 5.
